notes.title: Knuckles support! and steam leaderboards!
notes.notes:
Currently working on implementing knuckles support, this might not be a quick change, as there's a few things I'd like to do to make this feel... good.
Plus, who doesn't want to stroke a cat in VR? Before you throw them 60 feet through the air...
Also looking at implementing steam leaderboards and achievements, although this is proving a little trickier than I imagined unfortunately!
